draft_upgrade_state.note: None of the pieces below are wired to a live HTTP route or frontend page yet. They are offline research/consumer infrastructure only, verified end to end against synthetic and small real-shaped fixtures, ready to run the moment a real conformant dataset lands.

tier_1_minimum_required_fields.source: historical_replay_data_adapter_service.REQUIRED_PRE_DRAFT_FIELDS -- validate_schema requires every field non-empty and every *_as_of/draft_date field a real parseable ISO date, or the row fails BLOCKED_SCHEMA
tier_1_minimum_required_fields.important_gap_not_covered_by_the_schema_: REQUIRED_PRE_DRAFT_FIELDS does NOT include any real stat magnitude. A dataset can pass BLOCKED_SCHEMA/BLOCKED_LEAKAGE cleanly and still be USELESS to historical_ranking_bridge_service -- every player with no populated PROJECTION_STAT_FIELDS (or K/DST projected_points_override) is excluded from RankingResult scoring, and if EVERY row lacks stats the bridge raises HistoricalRankingBridgeError outright. Treat the projection-stat fields below as Tier 1 in practice for anything beyond a PLATFORM_ADP-only replay.

per_player_season_row__required_to_be_sc.non_kdst_positions: at least one of historical_ranking_bridge_service.PROJECTION_STAT_FIELDS populated: passing_yards, passing_tds, interceptions, rushing_yards, rushing_tds, receiving_yards, receptions, receiving_tds, passing_first_downs, rushing_first_downs, receiving_first_downs, return_yards, return_tds, fumbles_lost
per_player_season_row__required_to_be_sc.k_or_dst: projected_points_override (a single real pre-draft point total) -- these positions never use PROJECTION_STAT_FIELDS
per_player_season_row__required_to_be_sc.missingness_policy: a player missing this is EXCLUDED from the RankingResult entirely and listed in HistoricalRankingBridgeResult.excluded_players with value_status=MISSING_PROJECTION_STATS -- never scored as an implicit 0.0

for_the_optional_identity_check.file: historical_picks.csv (optional input to run_historical_calibration_readiness_v1.py and to validate_identity_completeness)
for_the_optional_identity_check.required: every real historical pick resolves to exactly one player_id present in the row set, or carries an explicit identity_status (any disclosed value) -- an undisclosed gap becomes UNFLAGGED_UNRESOLVED and blocks with BLOCKED_IDENTITY

preferred_but_nonblocking_fields.policy: never inferred from name/round/anything else -- only ever a real disclosed value or the False default

preferred_but_nonblocking_fields.default_if_absent: no feature value built at all (not even UNKNOWN) unless BOTH availability_status and status_as_of are present on the row
preferred_but_nonblocking_fields.note: status_as_of itself IS schema-required (a date key), but the availability_status VALUE it describes is optional
optional -- omitting it simply skips the identity-completeness check rather than failing the run

preferred_but_nonblocking_fields.field: additional consecutive seasons beyond the schema minimum of one
preferred_but_nonblocking_fields.note: preferred for a real chronological train/validate/test split per CALIBRATION_PLAN.md, not required for one season's mechanics to run

as_of_cutoff_semantics.outcome_as_of: must be >= draft_date, AND must be >= draft_date + 140 days (MATURITY_MIN_DAYS_AFTER_DRAFT, a disclosed round-number floor, not yet calibrated against any real dataset) or the row is BLOCKED_IMMATURE_OUTCOME -- a real but not-yet-final outcome snapshot, never silently treated as the season's final word
leakage_exclusions_hard_requirement: realized season-Y stats or outcomes as a ranking input
injuries/depth-chart changes/trades learned after the draft date
future ADP (any ADP dated after the historical draft date)
retrospective news/analysis written after the season
as_of_cutoff_semantics.column_name_leakage_guard: BLOCKED_FEATURE_TOKENS = adp, market, ranking, projection, fantasy_points, fantasy_points_ppr, trade_calculator, sleeper_adp -- any row key outside the declared pre-draft/outcome field set whose lowercased name contains one of these is refused outright (a deliberate literal copy of scripts/build_backtest_dataset_v0.py's own guard, not a new convention)

historical_row_to_rankingresult_bridge.mechanism: constructs a real ProjectionSnapshot from the rows and calls the real, UNMODIFIED redraft_engine_v1_service.generate_rankings() -- the exact function a live draft uses. No second scoring engine.
historical_row_to_rankingresult_bridge.caller_responsibility: profile (a real LeagueProfile) must already carry the historical league's actual scoring/roster rules for that season -- never guessed or defaulted by the bridge
failure_modes: HistoricalRankingBridgeError if NOT ONE row across the whole set has usable stat components -- refuses to fabricate a RankingResult from nothing

generate_rankings()'s own pre-existing 'insufficient universe' guard still applies unchanged: a position needing N roster slots must have >= N+1 scored players or RankingResult.errors is non-empty for that historical season -- never bypassed to force a result

historical_decision_state_requirements.state_constructor: historical_decision_state_service.build_historical_decision_state(bridge_result, *, season, as_of, pick_number>=1, round_number, owner_slot, rosters_by_slot, strategy_version, manual_assets=()) -> HistoricalDecisionState
historical_decision_state_requirements.caller_responsibility: rosters_by_slot must be built by the caller using ONLY picks 1..pick_number-1 for that historical draft -- the constructor cannot verify this itself, but DOES enforce that available_player_ids never includes an already-rostered player or a bridge-excluded player
historical_decision_state_requirements.decision_bundle_producer: historical_decision_state_service.evaluate_historical_candidates(state, *, candidate_player_ids, comparable_leagues, provenance, player_scores=None, picks_until_next_turn=1, seasons=200, base_seed=20260903) -> DecisionBundle
historical_decision_state_requirements.cost_of_waiting_note: uses a disclosed, versioned, ADP-distance survival heuristic (estimate_historical_survival_probability, SURVIVAL_HEURISTIC_VERSION=historical-adp-survival-heuristic-v1) -- NOT the live Draft Room's CPU Monte Carlo (evaluate_pick_candidates/evaluate_cost_of_waiting_v2/simulate_pick_now are deliberately NOT reused here: they depend on a separate draft_order() implementation in redraft_draft_room_v1_service, and bridging the two without dedicated alignment testing risks silent team-slot misattribution)
historical_decision_state_requirements.action_field_note: always UNSCORED on a historical CandidateBundle -- never mislabeled with the live TAKE_NOW/GOOD_VALUE/WAIT/DEEP_TARGET/WAIVER_WATCH taxonomy, which this heuristic path does not produce
historical_decision_state_requirements.uncertainty_label: HISTORICAL_PROXY (Championship Equity SE=..., survival heuristic historical-adp-survival-heuristic-v1)
historical_decision_state_requirements.outcome_isolation: this module has NO realized-outcome input at all -- outcome data is attached only afterward by the outcome evaluator, never during recommendation generation

identity_requirements.stable_player_id: one stable player_id per real player across every row/pick for a season -- required
identity_requirements.resolution_rule: every real historical pick resolves to exactly one player_id in the supplied row set, or is explicitly flagged with a disclosed identity_status -- an unflagged gap is always a hard block (BLOCKED_IDENTITY), never silently dropped
identity_requirements.convention_reused: the same identity_status disclosure convention (e.g. UNMATCHED / K_DST_UNREPRESENTABLE-style explicit flags) already used by the live-draft identity reconciliation work elsewhere in this codebase -- not a new vocabulary invented for historical replay
identity_requirements.team_code_aliasing: the data contract additionally asks for any team-code aliasing a season's real platform export used (LA/LAR, AZ/ARI, JAX/JAC-style) -- not yet enforced by a dedicated validator in this lane's code, callers should resolve to one canonical team code before handoff
identity_requirements.name_variants: a draft-scoped alias registry per player per season is requested by the data contract (same shape as the live-draft identity work) -- not yet a separate enforced field in the adapter's schema today, player_name is a single required string

values.UNKNOWN: no value could be resolved -- never defaulted to zero or a guess
values.NOT_APPLICABLE: the feature does not apply to this player/context at all
values.BLOCKED: a value exists upstream but is blocked from use (e.g. an unmatched ADP lookup)
values.STALE: a real value exists but is dated outside its point-in-time validity window

generic_feature_value_status_vocabulary.rule: every adapter and lookup path in this module returns an explicit FeatureValue with one of these statuses -- never omits the row or defaults to 0.0

values.MISSING_PROJECTION_STATS: no real stat components (or K/DST override) present -- player excluded from the RankingResult
values.UNAVAILABLE_HISTORICALLY: constant defined for use when a value genuinely did not exist historically
values.NOT_APPLICABLE: constant defined for a field that does not apply

dataset_level_validation_statuses.note: schema checked first since nothing else is meaningful on a malformed row; every individual check's full detail is still attached to the result even after one status is chosen

known_values: (plus the DATASET_VALIDATION_STATUSES above, surfaced when validation itself fails)

minimum_outcome_substrate_for_calibratio.shared_requirement_all_four: weekly realized fantasy production per player for the target season, scored under that historical league's REAL scoring rules (OUTCOME_ONLY_FIELDS: realized_weekly_points, outcome_as_of) -- the same rows already required by the base data contract for 'scoring the replay only,' no additional deliverable beyond what section on Tier-1/outcome fields already names
minimum_outcome_substrate_for_calibratio.team_score_calibration: roster_level_metrics(realized_roster, profile, replacement_points_by_position=None) in outcome_evaluation_framework_service -- realized_roster is a caller-built Sequence[RosterPlayer] whose .value is REALIZED (not projected) production; reuses the real roster_composition_report/optimal_starting_lineup_value, no second lineup algorithm
minimum_outcome_substrate_for_calibratio.pick_score_evaluation: pick_level_metrics(pick_number, selected_player_id, selected_realized_production, available_pool_realized_production, replacement_points=None, next_pick_available_player_ids=None) -- available_pool_realized_production must be every OTHER candidate that was ACTUALLY available at that pick (point-in-time boundary is the caller's responsibility, same discipline as everywhere else in this contract)
minimum_outcome_substrate_for_calibratio.championship_equity_calibration: season_level_metrics(source, regular_season_strength_percentile, simulated_playoff_rate, simulated_championship_rate, sample_size) -- source=OBSERVED forbids supplying any *_rate field (a single realized season has no observed probability); source=SIMULATED is required to report playoff/championship rates at all, and those remain labeled SIMULATED even when computed from real historical rosters -- real bracket/schedule data is NOT required for this pilot, only to ever claim source=OBSERVED, which this pass deliberately avoids per section 10's own instruction
minimum_outcome_substrate_for_calibratio.cost_of_waiting_calibration: player_rank_correlation(predicted_ranks, realized_ranks) [Spearman + Kendall tau] plus pick_level_metrics.made_it_back (whether the passed-on top alternative survived to the next pick) -- both computable from the same realized_weekly_points substrate already listed, no separate deliverable
minimum_outcome_substrate_for_calibratio.framework_note: outcome_evaluation_framework_service is pure/deterministic and reads no file/service itself -- it only transforms whatever realized production a caller supplies. All four calibration types are already implemented and unit-tested; none of them are blocked on new code, only on a real realized_weekly_points substrate arriving.

accepted_input_formats.primary_file: <dataset-dir>/historical_replay_rows.csv -- one row per (player, season), columns = REQUIRED_PRE_DRAFT_FIELDS union OUTCOME_ONLY_FIELDS union (PROJECTION_STAT_FIELDS or projected_points_override, per the Tier-1 gap noted above -- NOT yet formally added to REQUIRED_PRE_DRAFT_FIELDS itself, a real gap worth a HISTORICAL_DATA_CONSUMER_REQUIREMENT if the producer lane wants it made schema-explicit)
accepted_input_formats.optional_file: <dataset-dir>/historical_picks.csv -- real historical pick order, for the identity-completeness check only
accepted_input_formats.row_shape_note: no fixed file format is mandated by the Python contract itself (validate_schema/validate_leakage accept any Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -- CSV-with-these-column-names is simply what the one existing entrypoint script expects; a caller could also hand rows in as parsed JSON records with the same keys
accepted_input_formats.encoding_and_types: all *_as_of/draft_date fields must be ISO-8601 date strings (date.fromisoformat parseable); numeric fields (platform_adp, PROJECTION_STAT_FIELDS values, projected_points_override, realized_weekly_points) must be parseable as float; rookie is a boolean (or omitted)

calibration_entrypoint.without_dataset_dir_or_missing_file: runs the identical pipeline against a deterministic SYNTHETIC_PIPELINE_TEST_ONLY dataset instead -- every output explicitly labeled, never mistaken for a real result
calibration_entrypoint.always_writes: docs/codex/HISTORICAL_CALIBRATION_READINESS_REPORT.json plus a console summary, on every run (real or synthetic)

invalid_package_errors_and_statuses.dataset_validation: DATASET_VALIDATION_STATUSES (see missingness_semantics above) -- one explicit status per validate_historical_dataset() call, full per-check detail always attached
invalid_package_errors_and_statuses.loader: load_historical_replay_dataset(raw_rows) returns HistoricalReplayUnavailable(reason: str) -- never raises, never fabricates -- when raw_rows is empty or fails schema/leakage
invalid_package_errors_and_statuses.split: chronological_split raises HistoricalReplayDataError for: overlapping season assignments, any dataset season left unassigned, or a non-strictly-chronological train/validate/test order
invalid_package_errors_and_statuses.evaluation_runner: run_replay_evaluation raises HistoricalReplayDataError if a season has fewer available players than team_count
invalid_package_errors_and_statuses.ranking_bridge: build_ranking_result_from_historical_rows raises HistoricalRankingBridgeError for empty rows or zero rows with any usable stat data; generate_rankings()'s own pre-existing insufficient-universe guard still applies and returns RankingResult.errors non-empty rather than raising
invalid_package_errors_and_statuses.readiness_script_top_level: BLOCKED_NO_DATASET_FOUND for a missing/absent dataset directory (exit code 0 -- a validation block is treated as a normal, well-formed result, not a crash)

current_admission_gates.schema: validate_schema -- every REQUIRED_PRE_DRAFT_FIELDS key non-empty, every *_as_of/draft_date field a parseable ISO date
current_admission_gates.identity: validate_identity_completeness -- every historical pick resolves 1:1 to a row player_id or carries a disclosed identity_status (only run when historical_picks is supplied)
current_admission_gates.leakage: validate_leakage -- BLOCKED_FEATURE_TOKENS column-name check plus strict as_of date ordering (see as_of_cutoff_semantics)
current_admission_gates.provenance: source_sha256 + generated_at_utc threaded through ProjectionSnapshot/AdpSnapshot/HistoricalRankingBridgeResult, and every FeatureValue carries its own provenance_hash/source_as_of/feature_version -- the same provenance discipline the live DecisionBundle path uses (score_provenance_service.build_score_provenance), not a separate weaker standard for historical data
current_admission_gates.temporal_validity: chronological_split's strict train < validate < test season ordering, plus find_immature_outcome_rows' 140-day outcome-maturity floor
current_admission_gates.scoring_compatibility: the caller-supplied LeagueProfile must carry the historical league's REAL scoring/roster rules for that season (never inferred), and generate_rankings()'s pre-existing insufficient-universe guard (>= required+1 scored players per position) still applies unchanged to historical seasons
current_admission_gates.duplicate_player_season: find_duplicate_player_seasons -- at most one row per (player_id, season)

not_required_for_first_useful_3_season_p: Real bracket/schedule/playoff data -- season_level_metrics can run entirely under source=SIMULATED for playoff/championship rate; real bracket data is only needed to ever claim source=OBSERVED, which this pass deliberately avoids

Complete PROJECTION_STAT_FIELDS coverage for every player -- the bridge includes any player with at least one populated stat field (or K/DST override) and honestly excludes the rest via excluded_players; partial per-player stat coverage is acceptable as long as it is disclosed, not silently backfilled
100% resolved historical-pick identity -- an explicitly disclosed identity_status on an unresolved pick does not block the dataset; only an undisclosed gap does
Availability/injury/depth-chart status data -- availability_status is preferred-but-nonblocking; absent, the feature is simply not built rather than defaulted to a fabricated ACTIVE
A pre-built RankingResult, DecisionBundle, or any NWR scoring output -- Draft Upgrade's own code builds all of that from raw rows; the producer lane supplies rows only

More than one full past season to prove basic replay mechanics -- one season with a real full snake draft plus a genuinely-dated pre-draft board is the literal floor per the data contract; three consecutive seasons is Draft Upgrade's PREFERRED target for a real chronological train/validate/test split, not a blocking minimum for the first useful signal
A new missingness/status vocabulary -- reuse KNOWN/UNKNOWN/NOT_APPLICABLE/BLOCKED/STALE and the existing identity_status disclosure convention rather than inventing new terms
Any historical calibration/evaluation code, metric definitions, or the calibration report itself -- all already built, tested, and waiting only on real rows
process_note_for_the_historical_data_lan: If Draft Upgrade discovers a new data need while consuming a candidate package, it will emit a bounded HISTORICAL_DATA_CONSUMER_REQUIREMENT rather than acquiring the source itself, and will not modify the Historical Redraft Data worktree. Draft Upgrade owns validation, admission, replay, calibration, and model consequences once a candidate package arrives.
